TPU0 PCLKB/16, TGRA=374: 10 kHz (0.1 ms) tick, vec130

TPU0 ISR body: 75 one-shot timers (flags 0x11FED) + 2 blink timers (0x12038)
(id, ms): limit = ms*10 ticks of 0.1 ms
TPU3 ISR body: 4 timers in 100 ms units (flags 0x1203A)
TX time-out timer from setting 0x9AC3 (minutes) [inference for units]
TPU1 ISR body: next sample of the table at *0x20B00 -> DADR0
main loop: plays beep pattern 0x12041 (880 Hz / 1046.5 Hz)
TPU2 ISR body: pulses the selected speaker switch with a shrinking duty cycle [inference: pop suppression]
5 ms: ADC scan + SWR; 10 ms: VDD IDD ALC PO COMP S remote-keypad
SWR=(1+r)/(1-r), r=AN001/AN002; outside [1,5) for 9 passes while TX -> 0x20B6D (HI-SWR)
main loop: AF mute, meters, io_poll, power checks
after timer 0x13: PTT inputs, TRX sequencer, TX audio select, speaker route, AF mute, band data, keying
priority CAT TX1 > EXTPA > DATA > RTS > DTR > ... > VOX -> 0x1204D
TX allowed check, TXINH line, debounce, hang/delay, trx_state 0 or 4
CW keying from DAKY/RTS/DTR: SEND lines + sidetone beep
JP_P51 strap: switch destination code between restricted/wide pairs
PA2 SEND_A, forced 0 if ETUN_TXINH_REQ or TX line low
